note: Catalogue capture for the held tier-2 operator manual TM 9-2355-335-10 (Oshkosh M-ATV M1240/M1240A1/M1245, July 2012). It holds the M1240 as a wheeled entry. The manual publishes the identity, the vehicle curb weight and the gross vehicle weight rating, a maximum engine rating with no net basis, an automatic transmission and a tyre size code. It publishes no operating weight, no net power, no tyre width and no tyre diameter, so the entry is not runtime-ready and emits no runtime row. No real source maps an AEE game class to the M1240, so class_token is empty.
